title: Access-Control Training Assessment
summary: A neutral training record used to verify controlled-record handling and section-level disclosure behavior.

sections.title: Exercise scope
sections.summary: Approved context for the training record.
sections.body: This record describes a records-handling exercise only. It does not represent a person, facility, client, incident, research subject, or live operation.

sections.title: Evaluation criteria
sections.summary: Controlled training guidance available to an authorized session.
sections.body: The exercise is complete when the operator distinguishes information classification from physical access authority, verifies need-to-know before disclosure, and terminates the elevated session after review.

sections.title: Review annotation
sections.summary: The annotation is intentionally omitted from the published artifact.
